environment.description: Application deployed identically but with AWS WAFv2 WebACL associated to the ALB. The WebACL contains three rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with priority 100 in COUNT mode for logging, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' at priority 200 with a single rule using a RegexPatternSet that matches request query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:['"\x60]\s*(?:OR|AND|UNION|SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP|;|--|#|\/\*))` with action BLOCK and TextTransformation of URL_DECODE followed by LOWERCASE applied to AllQueryArguments, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in COUNT mode only. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics enabled for all rules with sampled requests.
